lines.zh: 我跟着下沉的东西移动。
lines.en: I follow whatever sinks.
My spikes cut the air.
This anchor ball turns its spikes out.
The chain clanks.

lines.zh: 铁链一放，我从梁上降下。
lines.en: The chain pays out and I descend from the beam.
I drag close to the ground.
I hiss through the air as I swing.
I stay in his orbit.
The spike ball drags me along.
I've lifted a little higher.
My swing keeps widening.
I swing your way.
Hanging there, slowly turning.
Every spike points outward.
The chain hangs and sways.

lines.zh: 我在等一个可以砸的东西。
lines.en: Waiting for something to smash.

lines.zh: 我的影子正好在你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow's right at your feet.
The iron is covered in old marks.
The chain holds me straight down.
I make no sound at all.
I move as he moves.
I hang up here, like this.
The air moves around me.
All my weight hangs on the chain.
I'll wait till you stop talking.

lines.zh: 我晃得很慢，但一直在晃。
lines.en: I sway slowly, but always sway.
You are standing right where the ball will land.
I could swing over at any moment.
You haven't looked above your head.
I can hit you without landing.
The chain is held very short.
My spike ball drops first.

lines.zh: 你的位置，铁链的末端记着。
lines.en: The chain's end remembers exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 你停住，铁球也停在半空。
lines.en: You stop, and the iron ball stops midair.
I'm much heavier than I look.
This height is exactly right.
All my spikes point downward.

lines.zh: 铁链声就是给你的提醒。
lines.en: The chain's rattle is your warning.
Step back and I'll shift aside.
My shadow is on your head.

lines.zh: 我一直在你上面，链条放得很短。
lines.en: I am always above you, the chain kept short.
This anchor ball smells more of iron than you do.
I can see clearly from this angle.
If you're still, I sway slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西挡不住铁。
lines.en: That won't stop iron.
I've already worked out the landing spot.
I'm swaying harder now.
The chain has gone slack.
One spike is bent.
I spun a turn before steadying.
There's a fresh mark on the iron.
I'm still where I was.
All I have left is the sound of iron.
That stopped my swing.
I've started swinging again.
I still haven't hit the ground.
Eating has nothing to do with me.
That's for the living.
Move it. I only need a position.
I can't reach that.

lines.zh: 你把食物举起来做什么？
lines.en: Why hold food up?
I don't need anyone to feed me.
That's in my arc.

lines.zh: 吃的？我只对重量感兴趣。
lines.en: Food? I care only about weight.
Put it away. Not here.

lines.zh: 我只要一点可以砸的东西。
lines.en: I just want something to smash.
You hit a spike.
I swung and the chain rang.
Don't walk under me.
If you stand, stand further off.
My arc passes through there.

lines.zh: 铁碰到骨头的声音很闷。
lines.en: Iron on bone makes a dull sound.
I shifted aside a little.
A spike grazed your shoulder.
I haven't fully stopped.
One step this way and you'll hit it.
I'm only an iron ball.
Saying that to me is useless.
Even my joints are welded shut.
Hanging on this chain is enough.
You shouldn't ask a weapon that.
An iron ball doesn't speak of it.
I keep turning slowly.
That has nothing to do with me.
I'm not listening at all.
My swing has grown stronger.
I pressed on it and it broke.

lines.zh: 我只有尖刺，拿不了东西。
lines.en: I have only spikes; I cannot pick things up.
It's stuck between my spikes.
That can't stop me.

lines.zh: 铁球一扫，东西滚到墙角。
lines.en: One swing of the iron ball rolls it to the corner.
Iron, that I know.
It fell far below me.
This has no weight to speak of.
I ground it into the soil.
Keeping it serves no purpose.

lines.zh: 你走进了我摆动的范围。
lines.en: You've walked into my arc.
I've got you from above.
My chain is pulled straight.
This height is enough to drop on you.
I pull back a little first.
There's something above your head.
My shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 铁链绷直前，再走一步就好。
lines.en: One more step before the chain snaps taut.

lines.zh: 我挂在半空，照样砸得到。
lines.en: I hang midair and still can strike.
I'm starting to swing.

lines.zh: 你听见铁链的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the chain?
My line passes right through you.
I've waited for you to stand still.
You're directly beneath me.
I won't be stopping.

lines.zh: 尖刺球悬着，只等链子松。
lines.en: The spiked ball hangs, waiting for the chain to slack.
You're still standing in place.
My swing is getting faster.
You just moved off to the left.
The chain rings. You can't mistake it.
Your shoulder is coming up.
I've corrected my angle.
Waiting for this swing to finish.
You slipped half a step left.
I come in from this side.
You've nothing to block with.
I'm nearly touching you.

lines.zh: 铁链的声音盖住了别的。
lines.en: The chain drowns out everything else.
Your breathing quickened.
One more swing will do.
This angle is the steadiest.
The round shadow on the floor shrinks smaller.
I'm coming down now.
You've raised both hands.
The last one is for now.
You can't get out of this arc.
The whole ball comes down.
Spikes rake across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 尖刺擦过护甲，火星四溅。
lines.en: My spikes scrape your armor and throw sparks.
That threw you aside.
The chain rings by your ear.
Half a step back — perfect.
I kick in from the side.
I smash a crater into the stone tiles.
You dodged very fast.

lines.zh: 我的刺勾住了你的袖子。
lines.en: A spike snagged your sleeve.

lines.zh: 铁链收回去，我升回梁上。
lines.en: The chain retracts and I rise back to the beam.
Your pauldron's dented.
I haven't used my full weight yet.
I've got you pinned at the wall.
The chain pulls me back.
One more swing and I'm there.
I've been hung in the air.
The chain snapped taut and I held.
All my spikes splay outward.
This height suits me.
I begin a slow turn.

lines.zh: 梁上的铁链，开始吱吱响。
lines.en: The chain on the beam begins to creak.
The smell of iron is everywhere.

lines.zh: 我找到了可以砸的地方。
lines.en: I've found something to smash.

lines.zh: 我的尖刺影子，罩住整条走廊。
lines.en: My spiked shadow covers the whole corridor.
No one needs to wake me.
One swing to test the chain.
I wait on this arc.
It's darker here than I expected.
I've risen a bit higher.
My spikes cut the air.
Nobody looks above their heads.
I'm held up by the chain.
I start turning, circle by circle.
There are no footprints of mine.

lines.zh: 我在等一个正下方的位置。
lines.en: I wait for a spot directly below.
Fire heats the iron through.

lines.zh: 我重重砸在地上，弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit the ground hard and bounced.
Water makes the iron heavy.

lines.zh: 冲击把铁球掀得乱七八糟。
lines.en: The blast flung the ball wildly.
Something struck the iron face.
That light made my chain vibrate.
I don't eat. I only rust.

lines.zh: 雷顺着铁链一直走上来。
lines.en: Lightning ran up along the chain.
Even the chain is gone.
